name: @jikida/scan
description: Fast, template-based security scanner for CI and the terminal. Scan any URL for exposed secrets, weak security headers, missing HSTS/CSP, insecure cookies, exposed .env/.git and TLS issues, or scan a local repo for committed secrets, known-bad dependencies and unsafe Docker/CI config. Graded, with SARIF and JSON output for GitHub code scanning. Zero config, no account to start.
author: Jikida.io — Next Lab LLC
